_about: The Sorting Hat's yes/no questions. Each question pits two houses against each other: answering yes gives points to one house, answering no gives points to the other. Edit freely, but keep the house names exactly Gryffindor, Hufflepuff, Ravenclaw or Slytherin, and give every question its own id.

questions.text: A troll is loose in the castle and a classmate is missing. Would you go looking for them yourself?
Would you use a little trickery to get what you want?
Do you like to plan several steps ahead before you act?
Would you risk your life to save someone you don't even like?
Is being kind more important than being clever?
Do you enjoy spending time alone with your thoughts?
Would you stay loyal to a friend, even when you think they're wrong?
Would you rather work in a team than on your own?
Would you break a school rule to do what you believe is right?
Would you happily spend a whole afternoon repotting screaming Mandrakes, just because it needs doing?
Would you stand up to your own friends to stop them doing something wrong?
Do you read books that nobody told you to read?
Would you volunteer to face a dragon in the Triwizard Tournament?
The Ravenclaw common room door asks you a riddle every time you want to get in. Would you enjoy that?
Would you like to have your face on a Chocolate Frog card one day?
If you found a bag of Galleons in a corridor, would you hand in every single coin?
Is winning the House Cup more important than playing fair?
Would you rather know everything than have everything?
Would you like to be Head Boy or Head Girl, the one in charge?
Do you love learning things just for fun, even if they'll never be useful?
